path.description: The fully-qualified function path in the format "module:functionName" (e.g. "messages:list"). The module name maps to the file path within the convex/ directory.

args.description: Named arguments to pass to the function as a JSON object. The keys and value types must match the function's declared parameter types.

format.description: Output format for the response value. Currently only "json" is supported and is also the default when omitted.
